headline: Poland updates multi-employer sick leave regulations for 2027
summary: Poland announced changes to L4 sick leave rules effective Jan 1, 2027, altering how medical leave is issued for employees holding multiple jobs.
why: Poland's Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) regulates statutory sick pay and labor standards across Polish employers.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Revisions to labor laws adjust employer sick-leave obligations for multi-job workers.
